veranderings.voor: Sommige groepe dans ook oor probleme in hulle eie gemeenskap.
veranderings.na: Sommige groepe se danse gaan ook oor probleme in hulle eie gemeenskap.
veranderings.rede: 'Dans oor probleme' reads a little stiffly; saying the dances are about problems is more natural and keeps 'sommige' and 'ook'.

vlae.rede: 'Storie' and 'verhale' are near-synonyms, so the phrase is slightly circular; not changed because a fix (e.g. 'n ou verhaal' or 'oorleweringe') could shift the meaning or register.
